Daily credits and withdrawals

The first credit for a new plan unlocks 24 hours after activation. It earns one more credit every 24 hours on the invested amount until the term ends.

Request withdrawals from the wallet. The daily withdrawal cap applies across wallet requests. The referrer earns 12% of the first funded investment, plus 1% of the invested amount each day a referred plan runs.
